/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Table withTableSorting withTableSelection Pagination Checkbox; rg -n -C 4 'Table|withTableSorting|withTableSelection|Pagination|Button view|Typography|Flex' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg 'docs/.*(table|pagination)|README.md|Table.*d\\.ts|Pagination.*d\\.ts' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -70; rg -n 'Table' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/legacy* 2>/dev/null | head -30; sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md; ls"
